newsitem.title: USA: Engelhard sees Q3 below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Engelhard sees Q3 below forecasts.

text.p: Engelhard Corp said on Tuesday it expects third-quarter earnings to be below current analysts' estimates with profits about $0.23 to $0.25 a share.
Engelhard, however, expects improvement in the fourth quarter and full-year earnings to reflect reasonable year-over-year growth.

Current third quarter estimates of key analysts who follow the company range from $0.29 to $0.31. Engelhard reported net earnings per share of $0.26 in the third quarter of 1995 and $0.96 for the full year.

Engelhard, a maker of specialty chemical products and engineered materials, said the third quarter weakness is driven by a combination of depressed economic conditions in parts of the paper industry, lower-than-expected sales of emissions systems, increased costs and a lackluster precious metals market.
Profitability in the fourth quarter is expected to return to levels comparable with the company's performance in the first half of the year, Engelhard said.
Anticipated improvement is driven by expected strong performances for both the company's automotive-emissions systems and chemical catalyst businesses, Engelhard said.
